    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        if res[r0][j]==bg: res[r0][j]=2
        if res[r1][j]==bg: res[r1][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        if res[i][c0]==bg: res[i][c0]=2
        if res[i][c1]==bg: res[i][c1]=2
    return res
for n in (1,2,3,4): print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
res=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    # outline gaps
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        if res[r0][j]==bg: res[r0][j]=2
        if res[r1][j]==bg: res[r1][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        if res[i][c0]==bg: res[i][c0]=2
        if res[i][c1]==bg: res[i][c1]=2
    # columns containing dots: fill whole column between bbox edges
    dotcols=set(j for i,j in pts)
    for j in dotcols:
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            if res[i][j]==bg: res[i][j]=2
    return res
print('all match:', all(f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in (1,2,3,4)))
out=f(ti)
# summarize changed cells in test
ch=[(i,j) for i in range(len(out)) for j in range(len(out[0])) if out[i][j]!=ti[i][j]]
print('changed cells:', ch)
print(json.dumps(out))

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    # full rectangle perimeter
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        if res[r0][j]==bg: res[r0][j]=2
        if res[r1][j]==bg: res[r1][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        if res[i][c0]==bg: res[i][c0]=2
        if res[i][c1]==bg: res[i][c1]=2
    return res
for n in (1,2,3,4,5):
    print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j in range(c0,c1+1): res[r0][j]=2; res[r1][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1): res[i][c0]=2; res[i][c1]=2
    return res
for n in (1,2,3,4,5): print(n,f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])

from collections import Counter, deque

def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set()
    out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); comp=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]!=bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(comp)
    return out,bg

def perimeter_of(comps,g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        for k in range(c0,c1+1): res[r0][k]=2; res[r1][k]=2
        for k in range(r0,r1+1): res[k][c0]=2; res[k][c1]=2
    return res

for n in (1,2,3,4,5):
    a=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    cs_,bg=comps(a)
    got=perimeter_of(cs_,a)
    d=[(i,j,got[i][j],exp[i][j]) for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(len(a[0])) if got[i][j]!=exp[i][j]]
    print(n,'match:',not d, 'ndiff',len(d), d[:8])

def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        if res[r0][j]==bg: res[r0][j]=2
        if res[r1][j]==bg: res[r1][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        if res[i][c0]==bg: res[i][c0]=2
        if res[i][c1]==bg: res[i][c1]=2
    return res
for n in (1,2,3,4,5,6): print(n,f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        v=res[r0][j]
        if v==bg: res[r0][j]=2
        v=res[r1][j]
        if v==bg: res[r1][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        v=res[i][c0]
        if v==bg: res[i][c0]=2
        v=res[i][c1]
        if v==bg: res[i][c1]=2
    return res
for n in (1,2,3,4,5,6): print(n,f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
import json
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

    for j in range(c0,c1+1): paint(r0,j); paint(r1,j)
    for i in range(r0,r1+1): paint(i,c0); paint(i,c1)
    return res

from collections import Counter
def analyze(n):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])

    for i,j,a,b in d[:12]: print('   ',i,j,'mine',a,'exp',b)

for n in [8,7,6,5]: analyze(n)

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    def paint(i_,j_):
        if res[i_][j_]==bg: res[i_][j_]=2
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    # vertical: fill gaps between dot runs per column within bbox
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        rows=[i for i in range(r0,r1+1) if g[i][j]!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:]):
            for i_ in range(a+1,b): paint(i_,j)
    return res
# check demos
for n in range(1,9):
    M=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    d=[(i,j,M[i][j],O[i][j]) for i in range(len(O)) for j in range(len(O[0])) if M[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
    print(n,'ndiff',len(d),d[:6])

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[list(map(int,r)) for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    def paint(i_,j_):
        if res[i_][j_]==bg: res[i_][j_]=2
    # full border: top row, bottom row, left col, right col across bbox
    for j in range(c0,c1+1): paint(r0,j); paint(r1,j)
    for i in range(r0,r1+1): paint(i,c0); paint(i,c1)
    return res
